2.5._with_video_note: With a reference video, kie.ai bills input video seconds plus output seconds at this lower rate.

2.5-final._note: Renders an existing 480p draft at 1080p with the same motion. kie.ai does not publish a separate rate; the 1080p rate is assumed and the ledger stores the real charge.

kling-3.0._note: kie.ai rates from https://kie.ai/kling-3-0: std = 720p, pro = 1080p. Sound costs more in std and pro. Takes a start frame, a start + end frame and up to 3 characters (2-4 photos each) in one request.
